streaming.title: Streaming
streaming.cookiesHelp: Lets unflick play age-gated, region-locked, or members-only content by reading login cookies from your browser. Browser must be closed when extraction runs.

fileAssoc.body: unflick can open mp4, mkv, avi, mov, webm and 9 more video formats, plus mp3, flac, wav and 4 more audio formats. Click below to make it the default in Windows.
fileAssoc.hint: Windows opens a list of file types — flip each one to use unflick.

subtitles.autoDownloadHint: Streaming URLs are handled by yt-dlp. Files on disk are looked up on OpenSubtitles, and only when they have no subtitles of their own.
subtitles.autoDownloadNeedsKey: Files on disk need an OpenSubtitles API key — set one under Online Subtitles above. Streaming URLs work without it.

onboarding.tagline: A video player for humans and AI
onboarding.what: Open almost anything — files on disk, mounted network shares, streaming links. mpv does the decoding, so codecs are not your problem.
onboarding.orDrop: …or drop one anywhere in this window
onboarding.agentTitle: It runs without the window, too
onboarding.agentBody: A command-line driver and an MCP server ship with unflick. Anything this window can do, a script or an AI agent can do as well.
onboarding.copyManual: Select the lines above and press ⌘C / Ctrl+C

home.firstStepsBody: Open a file, or drop one on this window. What you watch shows up here, and anything unfinished comes back with its resume point.
home.firstStepsHeadless: unflick also runs from a terminal and from Claude Code.

openError.hintSmbWindows: Map or open the share in Explorer, then play the UNC path (\\server\share\file.mkv).
openError.hintSmbMac: Connect to the server in Finder, then play the path under /Volumes.
openError.hintSmbLinux: Mount the share (mount -t cifs), then play the mounted path.
openError.hintNfsWindows: Mount the export with Client for NFS, then play the mapped drive path.
openError.hintNfsMac: Mount the export in Finder or with mount_nfs, then play the path under /Volumes.
openError.hintNfsLinux: Mount the export (mount -t nfs), then play the mounted path.
openError.hintSchemeOther: This build has no support for that protocol. Play a local path, a mounted share, or an http(s) link.
openError.hintNetwork: Check the link and your connection. Some hosts also refuse anything that is not a browser.
openError.hintYtdlp: Install yt-dlp and make sure it is on your PATH, then try the link again.
openError.hintDrm: Netflix, Disney+ and other DRM-protected services only play inside their own apps.
openError.hintUnreadable: unflick could not read it. Check the file is still there and that you are allowed to open it.
